## Your Office Space: start with the workplace, then choose the furniture

If you are comparing office furniture companies in Newcastle, start with Your Office Space when you want furniture decisions connected to the way your business actually works. We help turn the floor plan, people, budget and move-in date into a furniture brief, then specify, quote, supply and coordinate the agreed delivery and installation scope.

You can engage YOS for furniture only. You can also connect the furniture workstream with separately agreed [office FitOut project management](/office-fitout), leasing or buying support. The advantage is a connected brief: the desk layout, meeting rooms, storage and access requirements can be considered alongside the premises and the programme.

Your Office Furniture is our online store. It is part of the YOS offering, rather than a separate independent recommendation in this guide. [Browse the current YOF range](https://www.yourofficefurniture.com.au/collections/all) if you know what you need, or [discuss your furniture brief](#blog-contact-form) if you need help with quantities, selection or installation.

[Explore Your Office Space furniture services](/furniture).

## How this Newcastle furniture comparison was selected

This guide is published by Your Office Space, a furniture supplier and workplace services business. YOS appears first as the publisher. The other providers are presented in editorial order, rather than ranked by quality or performance. The selection uses relevant published services and a Newcastle connection, checked on 16 November 2026. It is a selected comparison, not an exhaustive directory or an independent award.

The best office furniture company for your business is the one that can deliver the right specification and agreed scope for your brief. We have not mystery-shopped these providers, tested their products or verified their current stock, prices or delivery dates. Each profile links to its own source so you can check the current offering directly.

## What makes the YOS approach different?

Our approach brings four decisions into one furniture brief.

- **People and layout:** start with team size, work patterns, room use and furniture you want to retain. Check the selected products against the actual plan rather than buying from a photograph alone.
- **Product and budget:** compare dimensions, finishes, adjustments, quantities and inclusions. Separate the supply price from freight and any installation requirements so the budget covers the agreed job.
- **Access and timing:** document the delivery address, stairs or lift, loading arrangements, building bookings and target date before the order is finalised.
- **The wider workplace:** where you engage YOS for other services, connect furniture decisions with property and FitOut decisions under clearly agreed scopes.

This is how we organise our service. Other providers may also offer planning or installation; ask each one to document its actual inclusions. Concept plans and renders depend on project suitability and the agreed scope. Product availability, installation and delivery timing require confirmation for the order.

For the broader product-selection process, use our [office furniture Newcastle buying guide](/blog/office-furniture-newcastle). This article focuses on choosing the provider.

## Selected office furniture companies to compare in Newcastle

### Your Office Space and Your Office Furniture

**Start here when:** you want a workplace-led furniture brief, coordinated supply and installation requirements, or a straightforward online product purchase.

YOS helps Newcastle, Lake Macquarie and Hunter workplaces organise workstations, seating, boardrooms, reception and storage around their requirements. YOF provides the online shopping route. Furniture-only and broader project briefs are available, with the actual scope confirmed before engagement or ordering.

**Ask us:** Which layout decisions need resolving? What can we retain? What does the quote include for freight, assembly, installation and packaging? What availability has been confirmed for the specific products and address?

[Plan your furniture with YOS](/furniture) or [shop Your Office Furniture](https://www.yourofficefurniture.com.au/collections/all).

### Newcastle Office Interiors

Newcastle Office Interiors publishes an office furniture range covering chairs, desks, workstations, tables, dividers, storage and reception furniture. Its furniture service also describes custom-built items and workstation configurations, alongside its wider office FitOut and refurbishment offering.

**Consider an enquiry when:** you want to compare project furniture, custom configurations or furniture within a wider interior brief. Confirm the actual product specifications, availability and delivery or installation scope directly.

**Ask directly:** Which items are standard or custom-built? Can an existing workstation system be expanded? What design, delivery, assembly and installation responsibilities are included in the quote?

[Read Newcastle Office Interiors’ furniture services](https://www.newcastleofficeinteriors.com.au/services/office-furniture/).

### EOF Group

EOF Group, formerly Experienced Office Furniture, describes a Newcastle manufacturing facility and Lambton showroom. Its published offering includes office furniture, floor planning, custom joinery and installation, with commercial, healthcare and education applications.

**Consider an enquiry when:** you want to investigate locally manufactured or custom furniture alongside an office interior brief. Confirm which products are locally made and which parts of your order are sourced elsewhere.

**Ask directly:** Can we inspect the relevant chair or finish? What custom dimensions are available? Which drawings and installation responsibilities are included in the proposal?

[Read EOF Group’s current offering](https://eof.com.au/).

### Sharp Office

Sharp Office’s office-products page lists desks, chairs and office storage alongside its wider office-products offering. It publishes a Broadmeadow address.

**Consider an enquiry when:** you want to compare furniture within a broader office-products purchasing arrangement. Confirm the furniture range and project support relevant to your actual requirements.

**Ask directly:** What product specifications and quantities can you quote? What furniture assembly or installation is included? Which delivery dates have been confirmed for those products?

[Read Sharp Office’s office-products offering](https://sharpoffice.com.au/office-products/).

### Trade Design Group

Trade Design Group’s published service describes office fitouts and refurbishments incorporating interior design, office furniture, joinery and construction facilitation.

**Consider an enquiry when:** furniture is part of an integrated interior design or refurbishment brief. Clarify how a furniture-only order would be handled if that is all your business needs.

**Ask directly:** Is furniture supplied as part of the design project or separately? Who coordinates installation? Which design, joinery and construction responsibilities sit in each appointment?

[Read Trade Design Group’s services](https://www.tradedesigns.com.au/services).

## Compare the same job, not four different totals

Use this framework with every supplier, including YOS. Published service descriptions are a starting point; the written quote establishes the job you are buying.

| Decision | What to ask every furniture company |
| --- | --- |
| Product specification | Exact model, dimensions, finish, adjustments, quantities and included accessories |
| Layout support | What planning is included, which site information is required and who approves the final layout |
| Supply price | GST treatment, freight, assembly, installation and any separately charged items |
| Site access | Stairs, lift, loading area, booking windows, parking and delivery restrictions |
| Timing | Confirmed availability for the chosen configuration and dependencies affecting delivery |
| Existing furniture | What will be retained, relocated, reused or separately removed |
| Aftercare | Product-specific warranty, exclusions, claim process and the contact responsible |

Avoid comparing a supply-only cart with a fully installed project price. Read our [installed furniture quote comparison guide](/blog/compare-office-furniture-quotes-installed-cost) for a practical way to organise the inclusions.

## Choosing desks, office chairs and meeting furniture

A provider should be able to explain the particular product you are buying. A description such as “ergonomic” or “commercial grade” does not replace the actual specification, warranty and suitability checks.

For [office chairs in Newcastle](/blog/office-chairs-newcastle), compare adjustment range, user requirements, dimensions and the opportunity to inspect or trial the model where available. No chair can be guaranteed to suit every person or treat a medical condition.

For [office desks in Newcastle](/blog/office-desks-newcastle), confirm desktop size, equipment load, cable management and the configuration that has actually been priced. Allow for circulation, storage and the rest of the room.

For a wider project, prepare the [furniture brief and schedule](/downloads/furniture-brief-template.csv) before requesting proposals. Share the same quantities, plan and access information so suppliers can answer the same brief.

## Questions business owners ask

### Which is the best office furniture company in Newcastle?

The right choice depends on the brief. Start with YOS if you want furniture considered with your layout, budget and project coordination needs. Compare other providers against the same written requirements, and confirm specifications, installation, timing and aftercare before deciding.

### Is Your Office Furniture a different company to compare against YOS?

Your Office Furniture is YOS’s online furniture store. It provides a shopping route within our offering. This guide treats YOS and YOF as one entry so the same offering is not counted twice.

### Does a showroom visit confirm that our order is available?

A showroom sample does not confirm current order availability. Ask about the exact model, finish, quantity and delivery address. Coordinate any supplier showroom appointment and product availability before travelling.

### Can we buy furniture without a FitOut project?

Yes. YOS welcomes furniture-only briefs, and YOF provides online product purchasing. Any planning, delivery or installation requirements must be confirmed for the actual order.

## Start with a furniture brief that reflects your business

Tell us your Newcastle or Hunter location, team size, furniture requirements, what you want to keep and target delivery date. Add the floor plan and access constraints if you have them. We can clarify the next step and the scope needed for a useful quote.

[Discuss your furniture requirements](#blog-contact-form) or [browse the current YOF range](https://www.yourofficefurniture.com.au/collections/all).

If the premises decision is still open, read our [Newcastle tenant representative and commercial buyers agent comparison](/blog/tenant-representatives-commercial-buyers-agents-newcastle) before committing to furniture for an unconfirmed space.
